{{Quote|Qillura is technically neutral. Unfortunately, its neutral status is likely due to end very soon.|[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Arligan Zey]]|<ref name="HC" />}}
The '''Qiilura system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Qiilura sector/Legends|Qiilura sector]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> within the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Orbit/Legends|Orbiting]] a single [[Star/Legends|star]], the Qiilura system contained the eponymous [[Farm/Legends|agricultural]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]], and was situated along the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] and [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="HC" />

At the start of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], waged between the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Army/Legends|armies]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Qiilura and its system were under the control of exploitative [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. In the aftermath of a Republic [[Clone commando/Legends|special forces]] [[Mission to Qiilura|mission]] to capture a Confederacy [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] on Qiilura,<ref name="HC" /> the Qiilura system became host to a Republic [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|military]] presence that was eventually forced to evict and resettle the planet's [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists elsewhere, in accordance with a deal that had been struck with the [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] [[gurlanin]]s. Though many colonists complied peacefully, [[Battle of Qiilura|hostilities]] eventually broke out on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld's]] surface between resisting farmers and the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] meant to oversee the evacuation.<ref name="TC" /> The Confederacy later [[Annexation of the Qiilura system/Legends|attempted to annex]] the Qiilura system. While a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] bearing the forces<ref name="MercyMission">{{TCW|Mercy Mission (episode)}}</ref> of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe's]] [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]]<ref name="104th">{{SWE|characters|warthog|Warthog}} {{C|relationships section for Clone Commander Wolffe}}</ref> was dispatched to intervene, the 104th was then recalled to the [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|mercy mission to Aleen]].<ref name="MercyMission" />

Following the Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Qiilura system fell under Imperial control. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, when the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy, Qiilura and surrounding [[Realspace/Legends|space]] was claimed as part of the Yuuzhan Vong's territory.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|A Jedi transport, on a mission to block Separatist annexation of the Qiilura system, is waylaid to provide desperately needed humanitarian relief to the people on the surface of Aleen...|Opening narration for "Mercy Mission"|<ref name="MercyMission" />}}
The Qiilura system made its first appearance in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|''Hard Contact'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[October 26]], [[2004]]. It later received another mention, albeit an indirect one, in Traviss' second sequel to ''Hard Contact'', entitled [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']], published three years later on [[October 30]], [[2007]]. In [[2011]], during the opening narration for the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episode "[[Mercy Mission (episode)|Mercy Mission]]," the Qiilura system was mentioned yet again.
